name: nccu-moodle-auth
description: Independent OAuth login/consent service for Ory Hydra: authenticates NCCU Moodle via SSO and relays a Web Services token. No dependency on the Python MCP.

comments.overrides: http-cookie-agent@8 (CJS, via axios-cookiejar-support) require()s agent-base, but agent-base@9 is ESM-only -> ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. Pin agent-base to the CJS 7.x line (API-compatible) until the chain ships ESM.
